text: Albanian bollards have a **black top** with a red and grey reflector. The bottom is painted white.
NOTE: Italy uses the same kind of bollards.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞的路樁頂部為**黑色**，帶有紅色和灰色反光片。底部漆成白色。
注意：義大利使用相同類型的路樁。

text: The Andorran bollard has an **orange** reflector and can be occasionally found on the main highways.
NOTE: This bollard can also be found in **Spain**.
text_zh: 安道爾的路樁帶有**橘色**反光片，偶爾可在主要高速公路上看到。
注意：這種路樁也可在**西班牙**找到。

text: Australian bollards are white, with a **red reflector** on the front, and a grey reflector on the back.
NOTE: New Zealand uses a bollard where the red reflector wraps around the back, meaning the reflector goes from end to end while the Australian one stops in the middle.
text_zh: 澳洲的路樁是白色的，正面有**紅色反光片**，背面有灰色反光片。
注意：紐西蘭的路樁，其紅色反光片會環繞到背面，這表示反光片是從頭到尾延伸的，而澳洲的路樁則是在中間就停止了。

text: Reflectors that are **shorter **in height than the regular ones are most common in Queensland and South Australia.
NOTE: This is most consistent with 4 or more short reflectors visible in the round. A low amount of short reflectors is less consistent. This is not consistent in Generation 2.
text_zh: 高度比一般反射器**較短 **的反射器最常見於昆士蘭州與南澳州。
備註：當全景中能看到 4 個或更多短反射器時最為可靠。少量的短反射器可靠度較低。這在 Generation 2 相機世代中並不一致。

text: Bollards with **brown paint** at the bottom are most commonly found in Western Australia.
NOTE: Brown paint at the bottom of [exposed bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/KuQaRmJgbJ6kBUda7) can also rarely be seen in other states, however the brown section will not be as large.
text_zh: 底部塗有**棕色漆**的路樁最常見於西澳州。
備註：[露出地面的路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/KuQaRmJgbJ6kBUda7)底部有棕色漆的情況在其他州偶爾也能看到，但棕色部分的範圍不會那麼大。

text: These black-and-white **stripy **bollards are unique to Western Australia.
text_zh: 這種黑白**條紋 **路樁是西澳州特有的。

text: This **black-and-yellow** bollard is exclusive to Queensland.
text_zh: 這種**黃黑相間**路樁是昆士蘭州獨有的。

text: Austria uses white** **bollards, with a **black top**. The colour of the reflector is **(dark) red or dark grey**.
Many bollards also feature a small nipple-shaped black cap on the top. Bollards sometimes have a [snow pole on top](https://goo.gl/maps/kkcrsQwXxFkn52rq8).
NOTE: Slovenia and Montenegro use the same bollards, but with bright red reflectors instead of grey or dark red. Germany uses simple white bollards with grey reflectors.
text_zh: 奧地利使用白色** **路樁，帶有**黑色頂部**。反光片的顏色為**（深）紅色或深灰色**。
許多路樁頂部還有一個突起的黑色小蓋。路樁頂部有時會附有[除雪桿](https://goo.gl/maps/kkcrsQwXxFkn52rq8)。
註：斯洛維尼亞和蒙特內哥羅使用相同的路樁，但反光片為鮮紅色，而非灰色或深紅色。德國則使用帶有灰色反光片的簡約白色路樁。

text: Since the Azores is an autonomous region of Portugal, you will often come across various types of Portuguese infrastructure, such as poles, chevrons and bollards.
text_zh: 由於亞速群島是葡萄牙的自治區，你經常會遇到各種葡萄牙基礎設施，例如電線桿、轉彎標誌和路樁。

text: Bangladesh uses **red-and-white** concrete bollards throughout the whole country.
NOTE: They can also be found in a square form instead of a circular form.
text_zh: 孟加拉全國各地都使用**紅白相間**的混凝土路樁。
註：除了圓柱形之外，也可以找到方形的路樁。

text: Belgium uses **white** bollards with a **yellow rectangular reflector **on the front and [white ](https://goo.gl/maps/dsvrRBcicD5XmBN59)on the back. A second type of bollard is [dark brown](https://goo.gl/maps/Wefn7bM6gmvjQ7DY7) with two red stripes at the top. Occasionally, other bollards can be seen.
NOTE: Denmark uses similar white bollards, but they have a red stripe at the top and the reflector is not rectangular. The dark brown bollard with two red stripes can also be seen in the Netherlands.
text_zh: 比利時使用**白色**路樁，正面帶有**黃色矩形反射片**，背面為[白色](https://goo.gl/maps/dsvrRBcicD5XmBN59)。第二種路樁是[深棕色](https://goo.gl/maps/Wefn7bM6gmvjQ7DY7)，頂部有兩條紅線。偶爾也能看到其他路樁。
備註：丹麥使用類似的白路樁，但頂部有一條紅線且反射片不是矩形的。頂部有兩條紅線的深棕色路樁也可以在荷蘭看到。

text: Bollards are generally **fairly rare** in Bulgaria.

When you see them, they almost always have this somewhat generic design, which is relatively similar to the bollards found in Croatia and Hungary. They have a red reflector on the front, and a white one on the back. The design isn’t terribly consistent: sometimes they are [thinner](https://goo.gl/maps/cHocfsUNELC32ANF6), and the shape of the reflector varies.
text_zh: 路樁在保加利亞通常**相當罕見**。
當你看得到它們時，它們幾乎總是有這種有些常見的設計，與克羅埃西亞和匈牙利找到的路樁相對相似。它們正面有紅色反光片，背面有白色反光片。設計並不是很一致：有時它們[較細](https://goo.gl/maps/cHocfsUNELC32ANF6)，且反光片的形狀也有所不同。

text: Cambodia has a variety of different **bollards**. The most common ones are:
- A stone bollard with red-and-white stripes.
- A stone bollard with a red top and a white base, usually with a reflector in the red part.
Some bollards are unique to a road or region. More details can be found in the region-guessing section.
text_zh: 柬埔寨有各種不同的**路樁**。最常見的是：
- 紅白相間條紋的石製路樁。
- 頂部為紅色、基座為白色的石製路樁，紅色部分通常裝有反射器。
有些路樁是特定道路或區域獨有的。更多細節可以在區域定位章節中找到。

text: Chevrons in Cambodia are **black with yellow arrows**.
Chevrons are somewhat rare. On many occasions, Cambodia prefers to use bollards instead of chevrons to mark curves in the road.
NOTE: Chevrons in all other Southeast Asian countries have the reverse colour scheme: yellow with black arrows.
text_zh: 柬埔寨的轉彎標誌為**黑底黃色箭頭**。
轉彎標誌算蠻罕見的。在許多情況下，柬埔寨更傾向使用路樁而非轉彎標誌來標示道路彎道。
注意：所有其他東南亞國家的轉彎標誌顏色搭配恰好相反：黃底黑色箭頭。

text: **Black-and-white bollards** in Cambodia are only found on Road 48, between Tatai and the intersection with Road 4.
NOTE: Make sure to check other clues before guessing, because this style of bollard is commonly found in Thailand.
text_zh: 柬埔寨的**黑白相間路樁**僅出現在 Tatai 與 4 號道路交叉口之間的 48 號道路上。
注意：猜測前務必確認其他線索，因為這種樣式的路樁在泰國很常見。

text: Unique **triangular bollards** with red stripes can be found in three places in Cambodia, all located in the same area in the southwest:
- On Road 4 between Angk Snuol and Preah Sihanouk. They are especially common in the section between Kirirom National Park and Preah Sihanouk.
- One small off-road of Road 4, in Ream National Park near Preah Sihanouk.
- In Preah Monivong National Park.
text_zh: 帶有紅色條紋的獨特**三角形路樁**可在柬埔寨的三個地方找到，全都位於西南部的同一個區域：
- 在 Angk Snuol 與 Preah Sihanouk 之間的 4 號道路上。它們在基里隆國家公園與 Preah Sihanouk 之間的路段特別常見。
- 在 Preah Sihanouk 附近的雲景國家公園內，4 號道路的一條小岔路上。
- 在波哥國家公園（Preah Monivong National Park）內。

text: Alberta has a unique **black and white **bollard that is often found at intersections. It has a **cylindrical **shape and two black bands that wrap all the way around. It is one of the most useful Canadian bollards to learn because it appears so frequently.

NOTE: Some Alberta bollards have a [yellow band](https://goo.gl/maps/VocoBEyMAyYWS6TNA) between the two black bands, instead of a white one. [Blue bands](https://www.google.com/maps/@51.0086521,-114.1574649,3a,15y,332.03h,76.57t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1swqH7OVkeCkEWjGass03ahQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) can also rarely be seen, particularly in and around Calgary, while [green bands](https://www.google.com/maps/@53.6289425,-113.3790425,3a,15y,31.12h,80.5t,0.35r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sOAFFhMEkY051OMV8geKMog!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) are rarely seen in and around Edmonton.
text_zh: 亞伯達省擁有獨特的**黑白相間 **路樁，經常出現在路口。它呈現**圓柱形 **，帶有兩道環繞四周的黑色帶狀標示。這是非常值得記憶的加拿大路樁之一，因為它的出現頻率非常高。

註：亞伯達省的部分路樁在兩條黑色帶狀之間是[黃色帶狀](https://goo.gl/maps/VocoBEyMAyYWS6TNA)，而不是白色的。[藍色帶狀](https://www.google.com/maps/@51.0086521,-114.1574649,3a,15y,332.03h,76.57t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1swqH7OVkeCkEWjGass03ahQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)偶爾可見，特別是在卡加利市區及其周邊，而[綠色帶狀](https://www.google.com/maps/@53.6289425,-113.3790425,3a,15y,31.12h,80.5t,0.35r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sOAFFhMEkY051OMV8geKMog!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則極少見於艾德蒙吞及其周邊。

text: Manitoba uses black and grey painted bollards. Most of the time an **orange stripe** will be present below the grey one.
[Wooden, rectangular bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fuj6Rivmhcg3sS5dA) of this form are typically found further north in Manitoba.
NOTE: Bollards in [this](https://goo.gl/maps/BmjVnBrvDfAc66Ym9) format with just a black top are seen in Manitoba and Saskatchewan.
text_zh: 曼尼托巴省使用漆成黑色與灰色的路樁。大多數情況下，灰色條紋下方會有一道**橘色條紋**。
這種形式的[木製矩形路樁](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fuj6Rivmhcg3sS5dA)通常見於曼尼托巴省較北部的地區。
註：僅頂部為黑色的[這種](https://goo.gl/maps/BmjVnBrvDfAc66Ym9)格式路樁可見於曼尼托巴省和薩克其萬省。

text: British Columbia has black-and-white bollards with a thin, slightly curved shape. It is most commonly found on Vancouver Island, but can be found all throughout the province.
NOTE: They can look superficially similar to the Alberta bollard. However, the thin shape and the wider spacing of the two black bands should help you tell them apart.
text_zh: 卑詩省擁有黑白相間的路樁，形狀較細且略帶弧度。最常見於溫哥華島，但全省各地都能找到。
註：它們表面上看起來與亞伯達省的路樁相似。然而，較細的形狀和兩條黑色帶狀之間較寬的間距應能幫助你將它們區分開來。

text: Québec has unique bollards that are always attached to guardrails. They are long, thin white poles with a **red** or **green reflector** at the top.
text_zh: 魁北克省擁有獨特的路樁，且總是附著在護欄上。它們是細長白色的桿子，頂部帶有**紅色**或**綠色反射鏡**。

text: You can find these **rectangular markers** on the sides of the roads in Québec. The colours can vary.
NOTE: These can be rarely found on urban divided highways in New Brunswick.
text_zh: 你可以在魁北克省的道路兩側看到這種**矩形標記**。顏色可能有所不同。
註：這些標記偶爾也會出現在紐布倫斯威克省的城市分隔公路上。

text: You can find these **diamond-shaped markers** on the sides of the roads in Ontario. The colours can vary.
text_zh: 你可以在安大略省的道路兩側看到這種**菱形標記**。顏色可能有所不同。

text: The Northwest Territories has a black and white bollard with a cylindrical shape and two **thick**, **black **bands.
NOTE: It looks very similar to the Alberta bollard. However, the Alberta bollard has thinner black bands.
text_zh: 西北地區擁有圓柱形的黑白路樁，帶有兩道**粗**、**黑色 **帶狀標示。
註：它看起來與亞伯達省的路樁非常相似。不過，亞伯達省路樁的黑色帶狀較細。

text: These flat, **yellow bollards** can be found on the Trans-Canada highway in New Brunswick.
text_zh: 這些扁平的**黃色路樁**可以在紐布倫斯威克省的橫加公路上找到。

text: Chilean bollards are similar to **Spanish style** bollards, with a white reflector at the front and a yellow-orange reflector at the back. They are not super common.
text_zh: 智利的路樁類似於**西班牙風格**的路樁，正面有白色反光片，背面有黃橘色反光片。它們不是很常見。

text: While regular bollards are somewhat rare in Chile, you may sometimes find this **orange**, temporary bollard, with **two white stripes** at the top.
text_zh: 雖然一般路樁在智利不太常見，但有時你會發現這種頂部有**兩條白條紋**的**橘色**臨時路樁。

text: Christmas Island uses the standard **Australian bollard**. It is a simple white bollard with a red reflector on the front, and a grey reflector on the back.

NOTE: In general, road infrastructure metas are similar to those found on mainland Australia, such as [speed limit signs](https://goo.gl/maps/bMWYvWn1yBfSiWs29), [green sign backgrounds](https://goo.gl/maps/EDq64mntxxcKBnrk7), etc.
text_zh: 聖誕島使用標準的**澳洲路樁**。這是一個簡單的白色路樁，正面有紅色反光片，背面有灰色反光片。
註：一般來說，道路基礎設施的特徵與澳洲本土發現的相似，例如[速限標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/bMWYvWn1yBfSiWs29)、[綠色標誌背景](https://goo.gl/maps/EDq64mntxxcKBnrk7)等。

text: The equivalent of a bollard in Costa Rica would be these vertical **orange boards** with **3 black circles** on them.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加的路樁相當於這些垂直的**橘色板子**，上面有 **3 個黑色圓圈**。

text: From the “Route 32 Toll” close to the San José and Heredia border until where it intersects RN 4 west of Guapiles, the road uses yellow bollards placed between the centre road lines.
text_zh: 從靠近聖荷西與埃雷迪亞邊界的「32號公路收費站」直到它在瓜皮萊斯以西與 4 號國道交叉口為止，該道路在中央道路標線之間使用了黃色路樁。

text: Croatian **bollards** are white with a black rectangle and red or white reflector. From the top, it is shaped like a triangle.

NOTE: Hungarian and Lithuanian bollards look similar**, **but have more **rounded **edges compared to Croatia’s sharper edges. Lithuanian bollards will also have an orange reflector. North Macedonia sometimes uses similar bollards, however the country is only covered in Generation 3.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞的**路樁**是白色的，帶有黑色長方形以及紅色或白色反光板。從頂部看去，它的形狀呈三角形。
備註：匈牙利和立陶宛的路樁看起來很相似**，**但與克羅埃西亞較尖銳的邊緣相比**，**有更多圓潤的邊緣。立陶宛的路樁也會帶有橘色反光板。北馬其頓有時也會使用類似的路樁，不過該國僅有第 3 代相機世代的覆蓋。

text: Bollards are superficially similar to Turkish bollards, with a red reflector at the front and a white one at the back. However, unlike Turkish bollards, they are not flat but rather triangular, with a slanted top.
text_zh: 路樁表面上與土耳其路樁相似，前方有一個紅色反光片，後方則是一個白色反光片。然而，與土耳其路樁不同的是，它們不是平的，而是呈三角形，且頂部有傾斜設計。

text: The Paphos Forest nature reserve consists of windy mountain roads with red soil on the sides, passing through the mostly uninhabited Mediterranean forest. You will not see any bollards in the reserve, with few exceptions.
text_zh: 帕福斯森林（Paphos Forest）自然保護區由多風的山路組成，兩側帶有紅土，穿過幾乎無人居住的地中海森林。在此保護區內除了少數例外，你看不到任何路樁。

text: A different kind of **bollard with a black top**, resembling those found in Slovenia for example, can sometimes be found in north-eastern Cyprus.
NOTE: The presence of regular Cypriot bollards does not exclude the highlighted region.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯東北部有時可以找到另一種**帶有黑色頂部的路樁**，例如斯洛維尼亞也能找到類似的款式。
注意：出現常規的賽普勒斯路樁並不排除所突顯的區域。

text: Bollards in Czechia have **orange double reflectors** on the front and a single white reflector on the back. There are also rarer [blue](https://goo.gl/maps/Hcc6dNhyH4bVS86N6) and [red](https://goo.gl/maps/8C1jWJLNWKQLpDxY8) variants.
NOTE: The only other country with the same design is Slovakia.
text_zh: 捷克的路樁正面有**橘色雙反光片**，背面則有一個白色反光片。也有較少見的[藍色](https://goo.gl/maps/Hcc6dNhyH4bVS86N6)和[紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/8C1jWJLNWKQLpDxY8)變體。
注意：唯一採用相同設計的另一個國家是斯洛伐克。

text: Denmark has a very recognizable white bollard with a yellow reflector and a **dark orange stripe**. This bollard is unique to the country. You may also find this [green variant](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9N1oFxNmpXjCDc5G8).
NOTE: Belgium has bollards that may look somewhat similar. However, it will never feature the orange stripe.
text_zh: 丹麥有一種極具辨識度的白色路樁，帶有黃色反光片和**深橘色條紋**。這種路樁是該國特有的。你可能也會找到這種[綠色變體](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9N1oFxNmpXjCDc5G8)。
注意：比利時的路樁看起來可能有點類似。然而，它們絕不會有橘色條紋。

text: You will rarely see these **stone bollards**, which may be painted red at the top, near bicycle paths.
text_zh: 你很少會看到這些頂端可能漆成紅色的**石路樁**出現在自行車道附近。

text: Ecuador is one of the few Latin American countries where bollards are very common.
You will find two main types of bollards:
- A **round** bollard with two red stripes,
- A **flat** bollard with two red reflectors on black.
Many other bollards can be found, however, they will almost always have the same colour scheme and style.
NOTE: A similar rectangular bollard can sometimes be found in Malaysia.
text_zh: 厄瓜多是少數路樁非常普遍的拉丁美洲國家之一。
你會找到兩種主要類型的路樁：
- 帶有兩道紅色條紋的**圓形**路樁，
- 帶有兩個黑色背景紅色反光片的**扁平**路樁。
然而，還可以找到許多其他路樁，但它們幾乎總是採用相同的配色方案和風格。
注意：馬來西亞 parfois 也能找到類似的長方形路樁。

text: Estonian bollards have a **round, baton-like shape**.
They have a rectangular reflector on the front and two circular reflectors on the back. The reflectors can be white or orange.
NOTE: Latvian and Lithuanian bollards look different.
!![This infographic](/images/estonia/nordics_bollards.png) shows the main similarities and differences between the bollards of the Baltic and Nordic countries.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的路樁具有**圓形、指揮棒狀的形狀**。
它們正面有一個長方形反光片，背面有兩個圓形反光片。反光片可以是白色或橘色。
注意：拉脫維亞和立陶宛的路樁看起來不同。
!![這張資訊圖表](/images/estonia/nordics_bollards.png)展示了波羅的海與北歐國家路樁的主要相似處與相異處。

text: Faroese bollards are small wooden sticks that are mainly painted **yellow **and sometimes** red on the top. **
text_zh: 法羅群島的路樁是小型木棍，主要漆成**黃色**，**頂端有時漆成紅色**。

text: Finland has **long black-and-white bollards** with a rectangular, white reflector on the front and two dots on the back. They can be either round or thin and curved. The black strip is typically diagonal.
NOTE: They can look somewhat similar to bollards found in other Northern European countries. [This infographic](/images/finland/nordics_bollards.png) shows the differences.
text_zh: 芬蘭擁有**長型的黑白路樁**，正面有一個長方形的白色反光片，背面則有兩個圓點。它們可以是圓形的，或是較細且帶有弧度的。黑色條紋通常是斜向的。
注意：它們看起來可能與其他北歐國家的路樁有些相似。[此資訊圖表](/images/finland/nordics_bollards.png)顯示了其中的差異。

text: The French bollard is extremely recognizable and appears very often. It is a **round white post with a pointed top** and a reflector band going all the way around. The band can be grey or red. Some rare variations have a [fully red top](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1zSoGbpiKic3nAxM6).
NOTE: A bollard that is commonly found in [Scotland](https://goo.gl/maps/CyjNmHyh5zyKv7qR7) looks similar, but has a blunt top instead of a pointed one.
text_zh: 法國的公路路樁極具辨識度且非常常見。這是一種**頂端呈尖狀的圓柱形白路樁**，帶有一條環繞一整圈的反光條。反光條可以是灰色或紅色。某些罕見的變體具有[全紅的頂部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1zSoGbpiKic3nAxM6)。
註：常見於[蘇格蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/CyjNmHyh5zyKv7qR7)的一種路樁看起來很像，但頂端是平的而不是尖的。

text: A different round white bollard, with two reflective indented bands, is unique to France.
You can also find this design in other colours like [green](https://goo.gl/maps/HiePkuYXrAFBQbyu9) or [yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/uKExi7xcUZjGZt316).
text_zh: 另一種帶有兩個凹陷反光條的圓形白路樁是法國獨有的。
你也能在其他顏色找到這種設計，像是[綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/HiePkuYXrAFBQbyu9)或[黃色](https://goo.gl/maps/uKExi7xcUZjGZt316)。

text: Less common wedge**-**shaped bollards with **wide** **rectangular white reflectors** on both the front and back are also unique to France.
text_zh: 較少見的楔形路樁，其正面和背面都有**寬**的**長方形白色反光片**，這也是法國特有的。

text: Germany uses these **black** and **white** bollards, with white and light-grey reflectors. The reflector will be [orange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/anxpwSBiE6Jfcntr5) on bollards next to intersections.** **They sometimes have plates containing the road number, and potentially other useful information. Many bollards also feature blue attachments on the side.

NOTE: Many European countries have similar bollards, however most will have different coloured reflectors. [Luxembourg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zK9RvWWR1d1NcnoS9) uses almost identical bollards, but they have 3 bolts instead of 2 on the reflector.
text_zh: 德國使用這些**黑色**和**白色**的路樁，配有白色和淺灰色反光片。交叉路口旁路上的反光片會是[橘色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/anxpwSBiE6Jfcntr5)。** **它們有時會有包含道路編號的牌子，以及其他可能有用資訊。許多路樁側面也有藍色附件。
注意：許多歐洲國家都有類似的路樁，但大多數的反光片顏色不同。[盧森堡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zK9RvWWR1d1NcnoS9)使用幾乎一模一樣的路樁，但它們的反光片上有 3 個螺栓而不是 2 個。

text: You will find an excessive amount of bollards on most roads in Germany. Around every 50 metres to be exact.
text_zh: 你在德國大多數的道路上都會發現大量的路樁。確切來說，大約每 50 公尺就會有一個。

text: Bollards with **darker reflectors** than usual are found in these regions.
text_zh: 配有比平常**更深色反光片**的路樁可以在這些地區找到。

text: Some bollards in North Rhine-Westphalia have a **green** bit at the top. The top can also be [another colour](https://goo.gl/maps/U6GkPR5z4NMDGqZc6).
text_zh: 北萊茵-威斯伐倫的一些路樁頂部帶有一點**綠色**。頂部也可以是[其他顏色](https://goo.gl/maps/U6GkPR5z4NMDGqZc6)。

text: These **round wooden** bollards, which have a painted top, are found in Bavaria.
text_zh: 這些頂部有彩繪的**圓形木製**路樁可以在巴伐利亞找到。

text: These irregular looking bollards, which do not have a white encasing on the bottom half, are found on K-roads in this region of **Lower Saxony**. K-Roads in this region will not have any other type of bollard.
text_zh: 這些底部沒有白色外殼、看起來不規則的路樁，可以在**下薩克森**這個地區的 K-道路上找到。這地區的 K-道路將不會有任何其他類型的路樁。

text: These basic **white plates** on bollards can be found in these states.
text_zh: 這些路樁上的基本**白色牌子**可以在這些邦中找到。

text: Bollards standing on these **black disks** are commonly found in all of **eastern** Germany.
text_zh: 站在這些**黑色圓盤**上的路樁常見於整個**東部**德國。

text: Rhineland-Palatinate is the only state where the plates on the bollards are **orange** instead of white.
text_zh: 萊茵蘭-普法爾茨是唯一一個路樁上的牌子是**橘色**而非白色的邦。

text: Similarly, Baden-Württemberg is the only state where the plates on the bollards can be **grey** instead of white.
text_zh: 同樣地，巴登-符騰堡是唯一一個路樁上的牌子可以是**灰色**而非白色的邦。

text: Greek bollards are wedge-shaped with **almost square reflectors**, being red on the front and white on the back.
text_zh: 希臘的路樁呈楔形，帶有**幾乎為正方形的反光片**，正面為紅色，背面為白色。

text: These small **white bollards** with **two black stripes** can be found on road 1 northeast of Quetzaltenango.
text_zh: 這些帶有**兩條黑條紋**的**白色小路樁**可以在克薩爾特南戈東北方的 1 號公路上找到。

text: **Yellow **bollards with a white arrow in a blue circle are commonly seen at pedestrian crossings, but also elsewhere, indicating where cars should go. There is a flat and a cuboid version.
text_zh: **黃色**路樁搭配藍色圓圈內的白色箭頭，常見於行人穿越道以及其他地方，用以指示車輛行駛方向。有扁平和平方體兩種版本。

text: Hungarian bollards are black-and-white, wedge-shaped, and typically have a **red** reflector at the front, and a white reflector at the back. [Blue reflectors](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.826971,20.8472466,3a,15y,282.66h,79.6t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9lVB-fYRUINpTrMAYWvYZg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) are also somewhat common.

NOTE: [Croatian bollards](https://www.google.se/maps/@44.9117293,15.1630293,3a,17.5y,144.5h,72.84t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sQHfQsXnyjPhm0AakdfHr0A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) are very similar. They do, however, typically have the reflector closer to the top, and appear somewhat [thinner](https://www.google.se/maps/@44.9122903,15.1621345,3a,48.7y,222.73h,52.12t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sbWEK8Fssx79YL61MpgzMqg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) than in Hungary.
text_zh: 匈牙利路樁為黑白相間、楔形，通常正面有**紅色**反光片，背面有白色反光片。[藍色反光片](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.826971,20.8472466,3a,15y,282.66h,79.6t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9lVB-fYRUINpTrMAYWvYZg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)也相當常見。

注意：[克羅埃西亞路樁](https://www.google.se/maps/@44.9117293,15.1630293,3a,17.5y,144.5h,72.84t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sQHfQsXnyjPhm0AakdfHr0A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)非常相似。然而，它們通常反光片較靠近頂部，且看起來比匈牙利的[稍微纖細](https://www.google.se/maps/@44.9122903,15.1621345,3a,48.7y,222.73h,52.12t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sbWEK8Fssx79YL61MpgzMqg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。

text: The road east of Tornanadaska, right by the border to Slovakia, can be easily recognized by the **snow **on and along the road, combined with the bollards and the railway right next to the road.
text_zh: 托爾納納達斯卡以東、緊鄰斯洛伐克邊界的道路，可以透過路上及路旁的**積雪**，結合路樁以及緊鄰道路的鐵路輕易辨識。

text: Iceland has unique **yellow bollards **with a white reflector. These bollards are extremely common and can be found throughout the country on almost every section of rural road.
text_zh: 冰島有獨特的**黃色路樁**搭配白色反光片。這些路樁極為常見，幾乎全國的每段鄉間道路都能看到。

text: Indonesia commonly uses these **black-and-white** square or circular bollards, as well as these **yellow-and-black** ones, which can also have a red reflector. Other designs can also be found.
NOTE: [UK-style bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YP74qg3Qj8Ugogus9) are mostly found in Kalimantan.
text_zh: 印尼常見這些**黑白相間**的方形或圓形路樁，以及這些**黃黑相間**的路樁，上面也可能帶有紅色反光片。也能找到其他設計。
注意：[英式路樁](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YP74qg3Qj8Ugogus9)主要在加里曼丹找到。

text: Central Sulawesi features these unique bollards that are painted **black **on the bottom, **white **in the middle, and **yellow **on the top.
text_zh: 中蘇拉威西有這些獨特的路樁，底部漆成**黑色**，中間漆成**白色**，頂部漆成**黃色**。

text: These **green and white bollards** can be a good clue for Ireland. They are not entirely unique to the country, but they are especially helpful in 50-50s with the UK.
text_zh: 這些**綠白相間的路樁**是愛爾蘭的好線索。它們雖然不是該國獨有，但在與英國進行 50-50 二選一時特別有用。

text: These **blue bollards** can commonly be found in urban areas.
text_zh: 這些**藍色路樁**常見於市區。

text: Italian bollards are triangular in shape, and white with a **black top**. They have a red front and a white rear reflector.
NOTE: Albania uses the same bollards.
text_zh: 義大利路樁呈三角形，白色並帶有**黑色頂部**。它們有一個紅色前反光片和一個白色後反光片。
注意：阿爾巴尼亞使用相同的路樁。

text: Japan usually uses simple white bollards with **circular reflector(s)** on the top. However, sometimes these bollards are [black](https://goo.gl/maps/cejvLnBS8MeHHbuU8), or have [other extensions](https://goo.gl/maps/DaSsHqZhpkmU3Duq8). They can also have the city or prefecture written on it in kanji.
_You can learn more about the bollards and kanji in the region guessing section._
text_zh: 日本的路樁通常是簡單的白色柱體，頂端有**圓形反光片**。不過有時會是[黑色](https://goo.gl/maps/cejvLnBS8MeHHbuU8)，或帶有[其他附加構造](https://goo.gl/maps/DaSsHqZhpkmU3Duq8)，也可能用漢字寫上市名或縣名。
_路樁與其上漢字的細節，可參考「都道府縣專屬線索」那一節。_

text: This flat, white bollard, found on the island of Kyushu and in Yamaguchi Prefecture, will have a **series of separated orange reflectors** on one side, and the same white on the opposite.
NOTE: Rarely, you may find similar bollards in Hokkaido. However, both sides will have orange reflectors.
text_zh: 這種扁平的白色路樁見於九州與山口縣，一面是**一整排分離的橘色反光片**，另一面則是同樣排列的白色反光片。
註：北海道偶爾也有類似路樁，但兩面都是橘色反光片。

text: Some bollards on the island of Shikoku can have a** black stripe** just under the reflector. They can be found normally, attached to [guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/dMX9b98ZsCAwWVm27) or [walls](https://goo.gl/maps/ibVKyN6TkXVVCgNm7).
text_zh: 四國部分路樁在反光片正下方有一道**黑色條紋**。除了獨立設置，也會裝在[護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/dMX9b98ZsCAwWVm27)或[牆面](https://goo.gl/maps/ibVKyN6TkXVVCgNm7)上。

text: This **thick**, white bollard, found in the Tohoku region, will have an **octagonal** reflector, and **yellow stripe** just underneath. In addition, you can find the same bollard, but with a [rectangular](https://goo.gl/maps/csG4xahLJ65kQnSf6) top.

Finally, there are two other variations. You can find a black [octagonal](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Sfi2HnuEoh8LvJNW6), and [rectangular](https://goo.gl/maps/DaNEMrzzZ1K42SsW9) version. They are often found on National Highways or Expressways and can have the number printed on them.
text_zh: 東北地方這種**粗**白色路樁配有**八角形**反光片，正下方是**黃色條紋**。另外也有頂部為[長方形](https://goo.gl/maps/csG4xahLJ65kQnSf6)的同款路樁。
此外還有兩種變體：黑色[八角形](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Sfi2HnuEoh8LvJNW6)與[長方形](https://goo.gl/maps/DaNEMrzzZ1K42SsW9)版本。這兩種多設置在國道或高速公路旁，上面可能印有路線編號。

text: This bollard, much like Tohoku, will be a **thick**, white bollard with an **octagonal** reflector. However, this Akita prefecture variation will have **two yellow stripes **underneath the reflector.
text_zh: 這種路樁與東北款極為相似，同樣是**粗**白色柱體配**八角形**反光片，但秋田縣的版本在反光片下方有**兩道黃色條紋**。

text: The Toyama prefecture bollard has **one reflector**, is [**extendable**](https://goo.gl/maps/dYgsuVzTtVHRbVrj7) and has a **red stripe** underneath the reflector.
NOTE: Be careful: if there is either a second reflector, or a yellow stripe instead of a red one, these are different bollards. These are more common variations found across many prefectures.
text_zh: 富山縣的路樁只有**一片反光片**，可[**伸縮**](https://goo.gl/maps/dYgsuVzTtVHRbVrj7)，反光片下方有一道**紅色條紋**。
註：要特別小心，如果出現第二片反光片，或條紋是黃色而非紅色，那就是別種路樁——那些是許多都道府縣都有的常見款式。

text: This bollard, with an **octagonal** reflector, and **red stripe** underneath it, is exclusive to the Okayama prefecture. Additionally, there will be a sloped connection where the base meets the reflector.
text_zh: 這種配**八角形**反光片、下方有**紅色條紋**的路樁是岡山縣獨有的，而且柱身與反光片交接處呈斜面。

text: This bollard, found in the Aomori prefecture, has **two yellow stripes**, a **single circular reflector**, and is **extendable**. Sometimes, only [one thicker stripe](https://goo.gl/maps/FznLNbxyMicDGqgaA) near the top may be present.
text_zh: 青森縣的路樁有**兩道黃色條紋**、**單片圓形反光片**，且可**伸縮**。有時上方只有[一道較粗的條紋](https://goo.gl/maps/FznLNbxyMicDGqgaA)。

text: These striped bollards (which cover over the original) have a **thinner** top half, and **no reflectors**, and are common to the Tohoku region. They are especially common in Akita prefecture.
text_zh: 這種條紋路樁（套在原本的路樁外面）上半段**較細**且**沒有反光片**，常見於東北地方，秋田縣尤其多。

text: A lot of Kazakh infrastructure, from pedestrian signs, poles, houses, to bollards, is very similar to what you see in Russia.
text_zh: 哈薩克的許多基礎設施，從行人標誌、電線桿、房屋到路樁，都與你在俄羅斯看到的非常相似。

text: Kazakhstan uses a variety of post-Soviet style bollards, as well as ones that resemble Turkish bollards. Notably, the bollards seemingly consisting of two thin bollards attached at a **90° angle** are unique to Kazakhstan.
text_zh: 哈薩克使用各種後蘇聯風格的路樁，以及類似土耳其路樁的款式。值得注意的是，這種看起來像是兩個細路樁以 **90° 角**連接在一起的路樁是哈薩克特有的。

text: Kyrgyzstan uses these simple white bollards with a diagonal black stripe near the top.
text_zh: 吉爾吉斯斯坦使用這種簡單的白色路樁，靠近頂部的地方有一條斜向的黑色條紋。

text: This **rocky dirt road** going to Chunkurchak is mostly high up in the snowy hills south of Bishkek. Some of the soil here has a **red tint** to it. On the [northern part](https://goo.gl/maps/v18zEDkdyTZVXwjc8) of the road, you can only see the snowy hills to the south. Also pay attention to the [red-and-white bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/fWt1rsU4FZ8wA5Z47) on the sides of the roads.
text_zh: 這條通往春丘克（Chunkurchak）的**岩石土路**大多位於比什凱克南方覆雪丘陵的高處。這裡的一些土壤帶有**紅色調**。在道路的[北部地區](https://goo.gl/maps/v18zEDkdyTZVXwjc8)，你只能看到南邊的雪山。同時也要注意路邊的[紅白相間路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/fWt1rsU4FZ8wA5Z47)。

text: Laos uses square concrete **black and white bollards** with one or more black bands.
NOTE: Thailand, Indonesia, and rarely Cambodia use similar bollards.
text_zh: 寮國使用帶有一條或多條黑條的方形混凝土**黑白路樁**。
註記：泰國、印尼和少數情況下的柬埔寨會使用類似的路樁。

text: A **red and white** painted cuboid concrete bollard can sometimes be seen a few metres off the side of the road.
text_zh: 有時可以在路邊幾公尺處看到塗有**紅白相間**的長方體混凝土路樁。

text: Latvian bollards have a **thin, slightly curved shape**.

They have a rectangular reflector on the front, and two circular reflectors on the back. The reflectors can be white or orange. The black strip is slightly angled. Bollards often have numbers below the front reflector.
NOTE: Estonian and Lithuanian bollards look different.
!![This infographic](/images/latvia/nordics_bollards.png) shows the main similarities and differences between the bollards of the Baltic and Nordic countries.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞路樁具有**纖細且微彎的形狀**。
它們正面有一個長方形反光板，背面有兩個圓形反光板。反光板可以是白色或橙色。黑色條紋略帶傾斜。路樁通常在正面反光板下方有數字。
註記：愛沙尼亞和立陶宛的路樁看起來不同。
!![此資訊圖表](/images/latvia/nordics_bollards.png)顯示了波羅的海和北歐國家路樁的主要異同。

text: Several sections of the A5 south of Nyakosoba are under construction. As a result, you will often see a sort of temporary “bollard” next to the road, consisting of a **stick** that is mostly painted** white**.
Even on sections without the bollard, you can often recognize this road, as it is a wide dirt road with very dark brown soil.
text_zh: 尼亞科索巴（Nyakosoba）以南的 A5 的好幾個路段正在施工中。因此，你經常會在路旁看到一種臨時的「路樁」，由一根大多漆成**白色**的**木棍**組成。
即使在沒有路樁的路段，你通常也能認出這條路，因為這是一條帶有非常深褐色土壤的寬闊泥土路。

text: Liechtenstein uses **black-and-white **cylindrical bollards** **with a white or grey reflector and a rounded top. They also often have a blue attachment on the side.
When attached to guardrails, they will use the [wedge design](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zDoFQvaitWHeGPhk9) instead.
NOTE: Switzerland can use almost identical bollards.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登使用**黑白**圓柱形路樁，配有白色或灰色反光片和圓頂。它們的側面也經常帶有藍色附件。
當裝在護欄上時，它們會改用[楔形設計](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zDoFQvaitWHeGPhk9)。
注意：瑞士也可能使用幾乎完全相同的路樁。

text: Lithuanian bollards are **wedge-shaped**.
They have an orange reflector on the front, and a white reflector on the back. Both reflectors are rectangular. You may find this [thin version](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ePfgVj54LmwVbQX68) as well.
NOTE: Estonian and Latvian bollards look different.
[This infographic](/images/lithuania/nordics_bollards.png) shows the main similarities and differences between the bollards of the Baltic and Nordic countries.
text_zh: 立陶宛的路樁是**楔形**的。
它們正面有一個橘色反光板，背面有一個白色反光板。兩個反光板都是長方形的。你也可能會找到[這個薄型版本](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ePfgVj54LmwVbQX68)。
注意：愛沙尼亞和拉脫維亞的路樁看起來不同。
[這張資訊圖表](/images/lithuania/nordics_bollards.png)顯示了波海與北歐國家路樁的主要相似點和相異點。

text: **Bollards** are black and white. They are wedge-shaped and have grey reflectors. Some have a distinctive [indent](https://goo.gl/maps/P4GMqrARAYXyAqRYA) in the lower half.

NOTE: They look more or less identical to [German](https://goo.gl/maps/6ELNoXaCi3LPUiML9) bollards. The most notable difference is that the reflectors on German bollards have two bolts, while in Luxembourg they have [three](https://goo.gl/maps/w92yU6hXM4GRDrH58).
The bollards of Belgium, the Netherlands and France look very different.
text_zh: **路樁**是黑白相間的。它們呈楔形並帶有灰色反光片。有些在下半部有一個獨特的[凹槽](https://goo.gl/maps/P4GMqrARAYXyAqRYA)。
注意：它們看起來跟[德國](https://goo.gl/maps/6ELNoXaCi3LPUiML9)路樁差不多。最明顯的區別在於德國路上的反光片有兩個螺栓，而盧森堡的有[三個](https://goo.gl/maps/w92yU6hXM4GRDrH58)。
比利時、荷蘭和法國的路樁看起來很不一樣。

text: Madeira commonly uses small and unique stone bollards with a red reflector. They are either cuboidal or cylindrical in shape.
text_zh: 馬德拉島常見小型且獨特的石製路樁，並附有紅色反光片。它們的外形呈立體方塊狀或圓柱狀。

text: Malaysian bollards will often have the colours **black**, **white**, **grey** and **red**. Here are three examples of typical Malaysian bollards.
NOTE: There can be multiple varieties of these bollards, but the layout is mostly the same.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的路樁通常帶有 **黑色**、**白色**、**灰色** 與 **紅色**。以下是三種典型的馬來西亞路樁範例。
注意：這些路樁可能有多種款式，但配置大致相同。

text: These small, **cylindrical** white bollards with a **black base** are unique to Mexico. A yellow reflector can sometimes be seen, as well as a flat version.
text_zh: 這些小型、**圓柱形**的白色路樁，底部為**黑色**，是墨西哥獨有的。有時可以看到黃色反光片，也有扁平的版本。

text: Bollards with a **red band** near the top are unique to Nayarit, apart from [one exception](https://www.google.com/maps/@16.416407,-94.109672,3a,15y,95.28h,64.73t,0.03r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s_lRtg1MKWPSNX_dJch3kig!2e0!5s20220501T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) being Federal Highway 190 on the Oaxaca-Chiapas border.
text_zh: 頂部附近帶有**紅色條紋**的路樁是納亞里特州的獨有特徵，[除了一個例外](https://www.google.com/maps/@16.416407,-94.109672,3a,15y,95.28h,64.73t,0.03r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s_lRtg1MKWPSNX_dJch3kig!2e0!5s20220501T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)即瓦哈卡-恰帕斯邊境上的 190 號聯邦公路。

text: Jalisco bollards will sometimes have a **crown** and the text ‘**Jalisco**’ written on it. These are usually barely legible unless very close, however no other Mexican bollard will have writing on it.
text_zh: 哈利斯科州的路樁有時會刻有**皇冠**以及「**Jalisco**」字樣。這些字樣通常除非靠得非常近否則幾乎難以辨認，但沒有其他墨西哥路樁會有文字。

text: Mongolia uniquely features white **bowling-pin shaped bollards** with two red stripes around the top.
text_zh: 蒙古獨有的特色是頂部周圍有兩條紅條紋的白色**保齡球瓶形路樁**。

text: The most common bollard is white with a red reflector on the front and a white one on the back. The bollard also has a black top.
NOTE: These bollards are also found in Slovenia.
text_zh: 最常見的路樁是白色的，正面有紅色反光片，背面有白色反光片。路樁頂部也是黑色的。
注意：這些路樁在斯洛維尼亞也能找到。

text: The Skadar Lake Bridge can be recognized by the **railway** and stone bollards next to the road.
text_zh: 斯庫台湖大橋可以透過道路旁的 **鐵路** 和石質路樁來辨識。

text: You can spot these **small stone bollards** at intersections and on the sides of roads.
text_zh: 你可以在路口和路旁發現這些 **小型石質路樁**。

text: The C34 looks like darker streaks of black sand surrounded by more sand as far as the eye can see. Some coastal shrubbery, and even the [coast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iYzuJD2UtEKEzAh27) can be seen in some parts. [Unique white bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A9USD6ywaLZWggcN8) with two yellow reflectors on the front, and one red in the back can also be seen along the road at regular intervals.
text_zh: C34 看起來像是被更多沙子包圍的深色黑沙條紋，一眼望去盡是沙子。某些路段可以看到一些沿海灌木叢，甚至還能看見[`海岸`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iYzuJD2UtEKEzAh27)。沿著道路也可以看見[`獨特的白色路樁`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A9USD6ywaLZWggcN8)，其正面有兩個黃色反光片，背面有一個紅色反光片，以固定間距排列。

text: Nepal mainly uses **black-and-white striped concrete bollards** that often have a **red marking** on the top. The amount of stripes vary from 3 to 5.
text_zh: 尼泊爾主要使用**黑白相間的水泥路樁**，頂部通常有**紅色標記**。條紋數量從 3 到 5 條不等。

text: The Netherlands has a simple, white **bollard** with a red reflector.

NOTE: On rare occasions, you can find round [French-style bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/vTgbpvfX35mcng4k8) with a red band and a pointed top. A difference with French bollards is that the red wrap usually does not go all the way around the bollard.
text_zh: 荷蘭有簡單的白色**路樁**，配有紅色反光片。
注意：在極少數情況下，你可以找到圓形的[法國風格路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/vTgbpvfX35mcng4k8)，帶有紅色環帶和尖頂。與法國路樁的不同之處在於，紅色包覆通常不會繞完整個路樁。

text: Some road markers (“**hectometre markers**”) have province-specific designs. This only applies to markers for regional N-roads, which have road numbers in yellow boxes.
Not all N-road markers have province-specific designs: some just have a generic design that can be found nationwide.
The A-roads all have the same signs and are recognizable because the road number is in a red box.
Bollards sometimes feature **kilometre stickers**, which are also limited to specific regions.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it. Image provided by Timzkii._
text_zh: 有些道路里程標示（「**百公尺標示**」）具有省份專屬的設計。這僅適用於 N 系列區域道路的標示，其道路編號位於黃色方框中。
並非所有的 N 系列道路標示都有省份專屬的設計：有些只是全國通用的通用設計。
A 系列道路的標誌全都相同，並且因為道路編號位於紅色方框中而易於辨認。
路樁有時會有**公里貼紙**，這也僅限於特定地區。
_你可以點擊圖片來放大。圖片由 Timzkii 提供。_

text: Bollards in New Zealand have a **red strip** which wraps around the top of the bollard. This strip wraps the whole way around the back and part of the front. The front or back of the bollard often contains a [**thin yellow**** **](https://goo.gl/maps/DLQi1D8i9rwS1hTA9)**or white reflector**.
NOTE: These bollards are unique to New Zealand.
text_zh: 紐西蘭的路樁頂部環繞著一條 **紅色條紋**。這條條紋完全繞過背面，並延伸至正面的一部分。路樁的正面或背面通常包含一個 [**細黃色**或白色反射器](https://goo.gl/maps/DLQi1D8i9rwS1hTA9)。
注意：這些路樁是紐西蘭特有的。

text: Two-digit state highway numbers follow a sequential pattern from North to South, making them easy to find. Single digit highways run through large parts of the country, but are easy to remember due to the small number of them.
NOTE: Bollards can sometimes have [highway numbers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HgbJ1hmxCHsPfi6z7) written on them.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 兩位數的國道編號由北到南依序排列，因此很容易找到。個位數的高速公路貫穿國內大部分地區，但由於數量很少，所以很容易記住。
注意：路樁上有時會寫有[公路編號](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HgbJ1hmxCHsPfi6z7)。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: A typical bollard, but with a** green stripe**, is common in southern Canterbury, as well as in some pockets in eastern Southland.
text_zh: 典型的路樁，但帶有**綠色條紋**，這在坎特伯雷南部以及南地大區東部的某些地區很常見。

text: A typical bollard but with a **black stripe** instead of a red one is commonly found in Wellington, especially in older Generation 3 coverage.
text_zh: 一個典型的路樁，但用**黑色條紋**代替紅色條紋，這在威靈頓很常見，特別是在較舊的第 3 代相機覆蓋中。

text: North Macedonia uses two types of bollards. One is rounded and very **thin**, while the other one is wedge-shaped. They both are white and have **red** or **white reflectors**, typically on a black surface.
NOTE: Croatia uses the same wedge-shaped bollard. Hungary has a similar wedge-shaped bollard but with more white space above the black rectangle.
text_zh: 北馬其頓使用兩種路樁。一種是圓形且非常**細**的，另一種則是楔形的。它們都是白色的，並帶有**紅色**或**白色反光片**，通常位於黑色表面上。
備註：克羅埃西亞使用相同的楔形路樁。匈牙利也有類似的楔形路樁，但黑色長方形上方有更多留白。

text: Norway uses thin, curved rectangular bollards with the reflector inside of a **black** parallelogram.
text_zh: 挪威使用細長且彎曲的長方形路樁，反光片位於**黑色**平行四邊形內部。

text: Bollards in Peru are painted red or yellow, and the country mainly uses a variety of **triangular-shaped** concrete bollards. Occasionally you will also spot other designs, such as these [circular](https://www.google.com/maps/@-14.4839611,-70.9887188,3a,24.9y,19.81h,72.8t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sU37DGxXpc0hXg0BPOLhRRw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) concrete variants.
text_zh: 祕魯的路樁漆成紅色或黃色，且該國主要使用各種**三角形**混凝土路樁。偶爾你也會發現其他設計，例如這些[圓形](https://www.google.com/maps/@-14.4839611,-70.9887188,3a,24.9y,19.81h,72.8t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sU37DGxXpc0hXg0BPOLhRRw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)混凝土變體。

text: This cylindrical bollard, with a **black and yellow stripe at the top**, is unique to the state of Moquegua, which is located in the south of Peru.
text_zh: 這個頂部帶有**黑黃條紋**的圓柱形路樁，是位於祕魯南部的莫克瓜州（Moquegua）特有的。

text: Polish bollards have a **red strip** that wraps all the way around the bollard. This strip has a red reflector on the front (sometimes hard to see), and a white reflector on the back. Bollards sometimes have numbers on them.
There is also a thinner, [curved](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wvnHofq3MFz4x8cm8) version of the bollard.

NOTE: The same design can be found in [Zakarpattia Oblast](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.4892755,22.8226335,3a,15y,293.62h,67.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sSZfQwOcH5qCjpxAWOGmgIg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) in Ukraine.
text_zh: 波蘭的路樁有一個環繞整個路樁的**紅色飾條**。這個飾條正面有一個紅色反光片（有時很難看清楚），背面則有一個白色反光片。路樁上有時會印有數字。
也有這種較細且[帶有弧度](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wvnHofq3MFz4x8cm8)的路樁版本。
注意：烏克蘭的[外喀爾巴阡州](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.4892755,22.8226335,3a,15y,293.62h,67.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sSZfQwOcH5qCjpxAWOGmgIg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也能找到相同設計的路樁。

text: Portuguese bollards are either wedge-shaped with a noticeably thin white top, or flat with a wide reflector. While most reflectors will be white, you may also find [orange](https://goo.gl/maps/5tWaAjwR2XWPHigU8) reflectors. These are noticeably darker than the [yellow reflectors](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.9861981,-5.1213523,3a,19.2y,201.17h,74.37t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sJ3baT-DirwydAJfMwHD0Pg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) in Spain.
text_zh: 葡萄牙路樁要麼是楔形且頂部白得顯眼，要麼是扁平且帶有寬反光板。雖然大多數反光板都是白色的，但你也可以找到[橘色](https://goo.gl/maps/5tWaAjwR2XWPHigU8)反光板。這些明顯比西班牙的[黃色反光板](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.9861981,-5.1213523,3a,19.2y,201.17h,74.37t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sJ3baT-DirwydAJfMwHD0Pg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)顏色更深。

text: **Bollards **in Qatar are only found on a few roads, and you can easily tell them apart.
- The horizontal [road just west of Qatar map label](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gTG4kNoWi6Nvgzgd9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) uses black and yellow centre lines.
- The horizontal [road south of Madinat al Ka`ban](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8zw6N5R1F83nVcoE7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) has a lot more greenery and, the coverage is also very overcast.
- The [coastal road south of Fuwayrit](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TccRhQzayTorZkmP9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) has coastal shrubs all around, and you can often see the coast.
- If the road doesn’t fit the above descriptions, guess on [the long vertical road west of Qatar map label](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zc4PecYmyuGQXYju7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng).
text_zh: 卡達的**路樁**僅在少數幾條道路上找到，你可以輕鬆地將它們區分開來。
- 位於 [Qatar 地圖標籤正西方的橫向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gTG4kNoWi6Nvgzgd9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 使用黑黃相間的中心線。
- [Madinat al Ka`ban 南側的橫向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8zw6N5R1F83nVcoE7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 有更多綠色植物，且街景覆蓋非常陰暗多雲。
- [Fuwayrit 南側的沿海道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TccRhQzayTorZkmP9#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) 周圍環繞著海岸灌木叢，且經常可以看到海岸線。
- 如果道路不符合上述描述，請猜 [Qatar 地圖標籤西側的長縱向道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zc4PecYmyuGQXYju7#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)。

text: Being a French Department, you will see **French infrastructure**, such as [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/g4Zs8JkqkiWbQYt28), [bollards](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.2427103,55.3131219,3a,75y,99.88h,80.84t,358.51r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfAEf2UYNe56no-OLI1RWoA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [poles](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.281482,55.4317286,3a,90y,19.99h,96.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm6b5qi8oScL85YCcGo5E_g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 身為法國的省份，你會看到**法國的基礎設施**，例如[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/g4Zs8JkqkiWbQYt28)、[路樁](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.2427103,55.3131219,3a,75y,99.88h,80.84t,358.51r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfAEf2UYNe56no-OLI1RWoA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)與[電線桿](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.281482,55.4317286,3a,90y,19.99h,96.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm6b5qi8oScL85YCcGo5E_g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: The two largest towns in Réunion can be differentiated by their **bollards**, commonly seen at intersections. Saint Paul uses [black](https://goo.gl/maps/BCFWSpgwGXQNRTZG7) bollards, while Saint Denis uses [green](https://goo.gl/maps/zKaQEWScWPr9oF4z5) bollards, often with white balls on top. Saint Denis is also more built up, being the capital.
text_zh: 留尼旺最大的兩個城鎮可以透過通常出現在路口的**路樁**來區分。聖保羅使用[黑色](https://goo.gl/maps/BCFWSpgwGXQNRTZG7)路樁，而聖丹尼使用[綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/zKaQEWScWPr9oF4z5)路樁，頂部通常有白色圓球。聖丹尼身為首都，開發也較為完善。

text: Romanian bollards are thin and white, with a **red vertical strip** near the top. It is worth noting that bollards in Romania are somewhat rare.
NOTE: Turkey has a very similar bollard.
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞的路樁細長且為白色，頂部附近有一條**紅色垂直條紋**。值得注意的是，羅馬尼亞的路樁相當罕見。
注意：土耳其有非常類似的路樁。

text: Russia has three main types of bollards: a very thin type being attached to a stick, one with a black top section and a red vertical reflector below and a German-style bollard.
text_zh: 俄羅斯有三種主要類型的路樁：一種是附著在桿子上的極細類型、一種頂部為黑色且下方帶有紅色垂直反光板的路樁，以及德式路樁。

text: Near intersections in Russia you will commonly see a very **large number of bollards**.
text_zh: 在俄羅斯的路口附近，通常會看到**數量極多的路樁**。

text: Along with containing a large number of bollards, many intersections are **unusually wide** compared to other countries.
text_zh: 除了包含大量路樁之外，許多路口與其他國家相比也**異常寬闊**。

text: Russian bollards that appear very thin and attached to a stick are usually found in the eastern part of the country, starting around Omsk. Note that [ordinary Russian bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/RnBNJE9kGwChsj9G7) are still plentiful in this part of the country.
text_zh: 看起來非常細且附著在一根棍子上的俄羅斯路樁通常能在該國東部找到，從鄂木斯克一帶開始。請注意，[普通的俄羅斯路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/RnBNJE9kGwChsj9G7)在該國的這一地區仍然十分豐富。

text: This unique bollard, with a **grey rectangle** and **double red reflectors**, is specific to the P100 in Kostroma Oblast.
text_zh: 這種帶有**灰色矩形**和**雙紅反光片**的獨特路樁是科斯特羅馬州 P100 公路所特有的。

text: Rwanda uses multiple different **red** and **white** **cylindrical** bollards.
text_zh: 盧安達使用多種不同的**紅色**與**白色**的**圓柱形**路樁。

text: The Nyungwe Forest National Park goes through a **lush** and **hilly **landscape, which has 2 distinct covered roads; The yellow NR10 is paved, with roadlines. **French style bollards** and** green lamp posts** can be seen on the sides of the road. The[ white NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) going south is mostly paved, except for the [southernmost section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6). No roadlines are present.
This coverage was taken with the **brown **Google car.
text_zh: 紐恩威森林國家公園（Nyungwe Forest National Park）穿過一片**蒼翠**且**丘陵起伏**的地貌，這裡有 2 條不同的覆蓋道路：黃色的 NR10 是柏油路，有道路標線。道路兩側可以看到**法式路樁**與**綠色路燈**。往南的[白色 NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) 大部分是柏油路，除了[最南端路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6)外。沒有道路標線。
此街景覆蓋是用**棕色** Google 車拍攝的。

text: Road signs and bollards are **generally identical** to the ones used in Italy.
NOTE: Many road signs give directions to the nearby Italian city of **Rimini**.
text_zh: 道路標誌與路樁**大致與**義大利使用的相同。
注意：許多道路標誌會指引通往鄰近的義大利城市**里米尼**。

text: Being a former French colony, Senegal uses French infrastructure such as **bollards**, **poles**, **signs** and **road** **lines**.
text_zh: 作為前法國殖民地，塞內加爾使用法國的基礎設施，例如**路樁**、**電線桿**、**標誌**與**道路** **標線**。

text: Serbia has a few bollard designs, however most of them will have an **off-centred reflector.** The bollards are usually flat, with no depth to them.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞有幾種路樁設計，不過其中大部分都有一個**偏心的反光片**。路樁通常是平的，沒有什麼立體感。

text: Moreover, all bus stops are protected by **concrete bollards** with unique black-and-yellow **warning bands**.
NOTE: Similar, but not quite identical designs are found in some Malaysian cities.
text_zh: 此外，所有公車亭都受到**混凝土路樁**的保護，並配有獨特的黑黃相間**警告條紋**。
注意：在某些馬來西亞城市也能找到相似但不完全相同的設計。

text: In addition to the concrete bollards on bus stops, Singapore sometimes has a unique and yellow **bus-leaving box** with an **arrow** on the street.
text_zh: 除了公車站的混凝土路樁之外，新加坡街頭有時也會出現一個獨特的黃色**公車離站方框**，裡面帶有一個**箭頭**。

text: Bollards in Slovakia have **orange double reflectors** on the front and a single white reflector on the back. There are also rarer [blue](https://goo.gl/maps/fL3eA8AWB8PgX29w7) and [red](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.3226818,21.4268942,3a,15y,317.67h,81.45t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sgokBvrgl2ArrDdOa4ar-1A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) variants.
NOTE: The only other country with the same design is Czechia.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的路樁正面有**橙色雙反光片**，背面則有一個單一的白色反光片。也有較罕見的[藍色](https://goo.gl/maps/fL3eA8AWB8PgX29w7)和[紅色](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.3226818,21.4268942,3a,15y,317.67h,81.45t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sgokBvrgl2ArrDdOa4ar-1A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)變體。
注意：唯一採用相同設計的其他國家是捷克。

text: Slovakia recently changed its standard bollard to a design very similar to the one found in [Hungary](https://www.google.se/maps/@47.1765642,18.80994,3a,19.3y,185.88h,68.68t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1scybzctaIto3MgG1bEOvhmw!2e0!5s20220901T000000!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4?entry=ttu): a standard European wedge-shaped bollard with a **red front reflector**. Note that for the time being, this bollard is still very rare.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克最近將其標準路樁更換為非常類似於[匈牙利](https://www.google.se/maps/@47.1765642,18.80994,3a,19.3y,185.88h,68.68t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1scybzctaIto3MgG1bEOvhmw!2e0!5s20220901T000000!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4?entry=ttu)設計的款式：標準的歐洲楔形路樁，配有**紅色正面反光片**。請注意，目前這種路樁仍然非常罕見。

text: Slovenian bollards are white with a black top. The front reflector will typically be **bright red**, while the back reflector will be **white**.

NOTE: [Austrian](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.935857,15.6009415,3a,20.6y,357.69h,65.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sak-sxymIs2V63Wt8uwtlKA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) bollards have the same design, but with a dark red front reflector and a black or grey back reflector. [Montenegrin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VKcVBeDadPfdZEwQ9) bollards also have a very similar design, also with a red and a white reflector.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的路樁為白色配黑色頂部。前方的反光片通常為**亮紅色**，後方的反光片則為**白色**。

註：[奧地利](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.935857,15.6009415,3a,20.6y,357.69h,65.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sak-sxymIs2V63Wt8uwtlKA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)路樁設計相同，但前方反光片為暗紅色，後方反光片為黑色或灰色。[蒙特內哥羅](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VKcVBeDadPfdZEwQ9)的路樁設計也非常相似，同樣配有紅色和白色反光片。

text: You will sometimes see these black and white wedge-shaped bollards. They have a **round yellow reflector** on the front, and a grey one on the back.
text_zh: 你偶爾會看到這些黑白相間的楔形路樁。它們正面有一個**圓形黃色反光片**，背面則有一個灰色反光片。

text: The standard Spanish bollards have a **yellow-orange** reflector on the front and two white dots on the back (though the back can also be blank). They are typically hollow.
NOTE: Very close to Andorra, you can find a [slightly different bollard](https://goo.gl/maps/7zfsuvqVcq5xhuTJ7), which is also used in Andorra itself.
text_zh: 標準的西班牙路樁正面有一個**黃橘色**反光片，背面有兩個白點（不過背面也可以是空白的）。它們通常是中空的。
注意：非常靠近安道爾的地方，你可以找到一個[略有不同的路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/7zfsuvqVcq5xhuTJ7)，這也是安道爾本身使用的路樁。

text: In Aragón, it is common to see this bollard design on regional roads.
It has a simple design, consisting of a short flat rectangular white stick with a grey reflector on both sides.
NOTE: There are [similar bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/S7WhiqK8rgF2caVt7) in other regions, but they appear much less frequently than in Aragón.
text_zh: 在亞拉岡，在區域道路上看到這種路樁設計是很常見的。
它採用簡單的設計，由一根短而扁平的矩形白棍組成，兩側皆有灰色反光板。
注意：其他地區也有[類似的路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/S7WhiqK8rgF2caVt7)，但出現頻率比亞拉岡低得多。

text: Within mainland Spain, this bollard is almost exclusive to the provinces of Lleida and Tarragona in Catalonia.

It features a more **square and orange reflector** on the front, compared to the standard Spanish bollard design. There is a **white reflector** on the back, instead of the two dots of standard bollards.
Some toll highways like the [AP-6](https://goo.gl/maps/Ce7fFoD835ZTPKzf7) also use this design.
NOTE: This bollard can also be found on the [eastern half of the Canary Islands](https://goo.gl/maps/uSyWhSZcGbTVX4dU8).
text_zh: 在西班牙本土內，這種路樁幾乎只出現在加泰隆尼亞的列伊達省和塔拉戈納省。
與標準的西班牙路樁設計相比，它的正面有一個更**方且呈橘色的反光板**。背面則是一個**白色反光板**，而不是標準路樁的兩個圓點。
像 [AP-6](https://goo.gl/maps/Ce7fFoD835ZTPKzf7) 這樣的一些收費高速公路也使用這種設計。
注意：這種路樁也可以在[加納利群島東半部](https://goo.gl/maps/uSyWhSZcGbTVX4dU8)找到。

text: In the region of Extremadura, it is common to see the normal Spanish bollards with **green tops**. This bollard variant is exclusive to this region.
text_zh: 在艾斯特雷馬杜拉地區，常見到頂端為**綠色**的標準西班牙路樁。這種路樁變體是該地區獨有的。

text: This **unique bollard design** is extremely common in the province of Las Palmas (which includes the islands of Gran Canaria, Fuerteventura and Lanzarote).
It features a more square and orange reflector on the front, compared to the standard Spanish bollard design. There is a white reflector on the back, instead of the two dots of standard bollards.
This bollard can also be found on mainland Spain, in the provinces of Lleida and Tarragona.

NOTE: The province of Santa Cruz de Tenerife (which includes the islands of Tenerife, La Gomera, El Hierro and La Palma) only uses bollards on highways, with the [standard Spanish design](https://goo.gl/maps/KXVo954u8dnxg5dy5).
text_zh: 這種**獨特的路樁設計**在拉斯帕爾馬斯省（包含大加納利島、富特文圖拉島和蘭薩羅特島）極為普遍。
與標準的西班牙路樁設計相比，它的正面有一個更方且呈橘色的反光板。背面則是一個白色反光板，而不是標準路樁的兩個圓點。
這種路樁也可以在西班牙本土的列伊達省和塔拉戈納省找到。
注意：聖克魯斯-德特內里費省（包含特內里費島、戈梅拉島、耶羅島和拉帕爾馬島）僅在高速公路上使用路樁，且採用[標準的西班牙設計](https://goo.gl/maps/KXVo954u8dnxg5dy5)。

text: The AP-15 in Navarra features unique bollards with a simple flat design and a square red reflector. Guardrails also have [red reflectors](https://maps.app.goo.gl/c9X1ak7KB5EhdDqRA) unlike the rest of Spain.
text_zh: 納瓦拉（Navarra）的 AP-15 高速公路上有獨特的簡單平坦設計路樁，並配有方形紅色反光板。與西班牙其他地區不同，這裡的護欄也帶有 [紅色反光板](https://maps.app.goo.gl/c9X1ak7KB5EhdDqRA)。

text: These short, wide **stone bollards** are unique to Sri Lanka. They have a tapered shape, with a black base and a white top.
text_zh: 這些矮而寬的 **石製路樁** 是斯里蘭卡特有的。它們呈錐形，底部為黑色，頂部為白色。

text: Swedish bollards are **black-and-white**, typically with a grey reflector. Reflectors by intersections are commonly [orange](https://www.google.se/maps/@59.8512352,17.453607,3a,15y,166.33h,79.23t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sCGMaRAFZgTy9i6vPJzOdVw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) instead. They can be either wedge-shaped, round, or [thin and curved](https://www.google.se/maps/@63.1586703,15.7505356,3a,17.6y,267.59h,81.22t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sZlG-VuwEFYfbbUAPnZQLUA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192).
text_zh: 瑞典的路樁通常是**黑白相間**的，且通常配有灰色反光片。交叉路口處的反光片通常則是[橘色](https://www.google.se/maps/@59.8512352,17.453607,3a,15y,166.33h,79.23t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sCGMaRAFZgTy9i6vPJzOdVw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)。它們可以是楔形、圓形，或是[細長且帶有弧度](https://www.google.se/maps/@63.1586703,15.7505356,3a,17.6y,267.59h,81.22t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sZlG-VuwEFYfbbUAPnZQLUA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的形狀。

text: **Wedge-shaped bollards**, similar to those found in Germany, are most common in the southern regions of the country.
text_zh: 類似德國常見的**楔形路樁**，在該國南部地區最為常見。

text: **Cylindrical bollards**, with a completely **horizontal black section** near the top, are most commonly found near the west coast and in Värmland and southern Dalarna.
text_zh: 頂部附近有完全**水平黑色區塊**的**圓柱形路樁**，最常見於西海岸、韋姆蘭（Värmland）以及達拉納南部。

text: **Flat bollards**, or cylindrical bollards with a **black rectangle** containing the reflector are most commonly found on major roads in the northern half of the country.

Beware that [one type](https://goo.gl/maps/Gdk6L1EZaGfwqyeZ9) of flat bollards can look similar to the [cylindrical bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/Hzdpy61j8fyitpG19) from the last tip, however the black section here is not horizontal.
text_zh: **扁平路樁**，或是帶有包含反光片之**黑色長方形**的圓柱形路樁，最常見於全國北半部的主要道路上。
請注意，[其中一種](https://goo.gl/maps/Gdk6L1EZaGfwqyeZ9)扁平路樁看起來可能與上一則提示中的[圓柱形路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/Hzdpy61j8fyitpG19)相似，但這裡的黑色區塊並非水平的。

text: These small white bollards with either a blue or a red strip near the top can be found in the countryside of Skåne.

NOTE: You may occasionally find [similar bollards](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.5722957,17.5222291,3a,15y,357.22h,76.22t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s2avuuRk8zAk_JOnWugKCsw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) in urban areas further north.
text_zh: 這些頂部附近帶有藍色或紅色條紋的小型白色路樁，可以在斯堪ane（Skåne）的鄉間找到。
注意：你偶爾可以在更北方的市區找到[相似的路樁](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.5722957,17.5222291,3a,15y,357.22h,76.22t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s2avuuRk8zAk_JOnWugKCsw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。

text: Swiss bollards are **black-and-white **with white or grey reflectors. They can be either wedge-shaped or cylindrical with a rounded top.
NOTE: Liechtenstein uses almost identical [round bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JJSg67HrDHerzv8c7).
text_zh: 瑞士路樁是**黑白相間的**，配有白色或灰色反光片。它們可以是楔形或帶有圓頂的圓柱形。
注意：列支敦斯登使用幾乎相同的[圓形路樁](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JJSg67HrDHerzv8c7)。

text: In the canton of Valais, you will often see thick wooden bollards, which can either be **square-shaped** or **cylindrical**.
text_zh: 在瓦萊州，你經常會看到粗大的木製路樁，其形狀可能是**方形**或**圓柱形**。

text: In place of bollards, reflectors in the canton of Glarus will often be **attached to fences** following the road.
text_zh: 在格勞日斯州，道路旁的反射器通常不會使用路樁，而是**固定在圍籬上**。

text: Taiwan uses these bollards with either two or three **circular reflectors** on a black rectangle.
You can also find these **lollipop** looking reflectors on guardrails, similar to the designs found in [Japan](https://goo.gl/maps/JvYoen6Zsh9iptr16).
text_zh: 台灣的路樁是黑色長方形上加兩顆或三顆**圓形反光片**。
護欄上還能看到這種**棒棒糖**造型的反光標，與[日本](https://goo.gl/maps/JvYoen6Zsh9iptr16)的設計相似。

text: The Thai bollard is square shaped with a pointed top, and has **black-and-white stripes**.
NOTE: In Southeast Asia, these bollards are also found in Cambodia, Laos and Indonesia.
text_zh: 泰國的路樁呈方形且頂部尖銳，帶有**黑白相間的條紋**。
註：在東南亞，柬埔寨、寮國和印尼也能見到這種路樁。

text: This **black bollard** with **three large white reflectors** is most frequently seen in Chiang Mai and Mae Hong Son.
text_zh: 這種帶有**三個大型白色反光片**的**黑色路樁**最常出現在清邁和湄宏順（Mae Hong Son）。

text: Turkish **bollards** have a simple design: rectangular, plain white, and with a red reflector on the front. They are thin when seen from the side.
There is a rare [yellow](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDsyYaBcT9Hpmbpk9) version, seen in some areas with high snowfall.
NOTE: Romania has similar bollards. However, bollards are relatively rare in Romania.
text_zh: 土耳其的**路樁**設計簡單：長方形、純白色，正面有紅色反光片。從側面看很薄。
在某些降雪量大的地區，可以看到罕見的[黃色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDsyYaBcT9Hpmbpk9)版本。
注意：羅馬尼亞也有類似的路樁。然而，路樁在羅馬尼亞相對少見。

text: These **“Polish” bollards** can be found in the Zakarpattia Oblast. They have a red reflector that wraps around the bollard.
They are identical to the standard bollard used in Poland (hence the name).
text_zh: 這些**「波蘭式」路樁**可以在外喀爾巴阡州找到。它們有一個環繞路樁的紅色反光條。
它們與波蘭使用的標準路樁完全相同（因此得名）。

text: The most common **bollard** in the UK looks like this. It has a rounded shape, with a red reflector on the front and a white one on the back. The base and top are black, with a white stripe in the middle.
text_zh: 英國最常見的**路樁**長這樣。它具有圓形外形，正面有一個紅色反光片，背面有一個白色反光片。底部和頂部是黑色的，中間有一條白色的條紋。

text: This **yellow traffic bollard** is commonly found in the UK.
text_zh: 這個**黃色交通路樁**在英國很常見。

text: In Scotland, you can often find these **red and white bollards**. They are round, bulky, and have a red-and-grey reflector that wraps all the way around.
They are sometimes found in other parts of the UK.
NOTE: The bollard looks similar to the French one. However, there are some small differences. For example, the Scottish bollard is round on the top, while the French one is more spiked.
text_zh: 在蘇格蘭，你經常可以找到這些**紅白相間的路樁**。它們是圓形且笨重的，並有一個環繞整圈的紅灰色反光片。
它們有時也會在英國的其他地方被找到。
注意：這個路樁看起來與法國的路樁相似。然而，有一些小的差異。例如，蘇格蘭路樁的頂部是圓形的，而法國路樁則更尖。

text: This bollard is found in **Nevada**. It consists of a reflector on a thin stick. The reflector is a vertical rectangle that consists of a white field surrounded by a black outline.
text_zh: 這種路樁見於**內華達州**。它由細桿上的反光片組成。反光片是一個垂直的長方形，由周圍有黑色外框的白色區塊組成。

text: Bollards in Colorado and Wyoming often feature a dark metal post with a **white circular reflector**, but it is not fully on the top of the post; instead, **part of the post goes above the reflector**.
The **top** of the metal pole is sometimes painted [white or grey](https://maps.app.goo.gl/atZPypoYhE7vNKZk9), which is unique to Wyoming.
text_zh: 科羅拉多州和懷俄明州的護欄路樁通常具有帶有**白色圓形反光片**的深色金屬柱，但它並非完全位於柱子頂端；相反地，**柱子的一部分會高出反光片**。
金屬桿的**頂部**有時會漆成[白色或灰色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/atZPypoYhE7vNKZk9)，這是懷俄明州特有的特徵。

text: The state of Washington uses bollards that consist of a [white](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JWXyCzVvNiAQ4NVV8) or [brown](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rCAieVzcSH1mrbST9) post with a white rectangle on the front of the bollard, and** two smaller white or silver squares **on the back of the bollard.
text_zh: 華盛頓州的路樁是由[白色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JWXyCzVvNiAQ4NVV8)或[棕色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rCAieVzcSH1mrbST9)的柱子組成，路樁正面有一個白色長方形，背面則有**兩個較小的白色或銀色正方形**。

text: A bollard consisting of a **white square reflector** on top of a **black rectangle reflector** is unique to Utah.
text_zh: 由位於**黑色長方形反光板**上方的**白色正方形反光板**組成的路樁是猶他州特有的。

text: The most common type of roadside bollard in South Dakota and Montana features a **white diamond **reflector on top.
Montana tends to have [1 bolt](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rpu2S7wW7cq7UCXV9) on the reflector, while South Dakota tends to have 2.
NOTE: This is a common design and can be found in many states. Additionally, square bollards can be rotated on their side to look like diamonds. Use with caution.
text_zh: 南達科他州和蒙大拿州最常見的路邊路樁類型，其頂部皆有**白色菱形**反光板。
蒙大拿州的反光板通常有 [1 個螺栓](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rpu2S7wW7cq7UCXV9)，而南達科他州通常有 2 個。
注意：這是一種常見的設計，可在許多州找到。此外，方形路樁可以側向旋轉看起來像菱形。請謹慎使用。

text: The most common type of bollard in Oregon has a very **long rectangular reflector** on top.
NOTE: Similar [bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DTmzW8bgvgTMnHhf7) exist in California.
text_zh: 俄勒岡州最常見的路樁類型頂部有一個非常**長的長方形反光板**。
注意：加州也有類似的[路樁](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DTmzW8bgvgTMnHhf7)。

text: **Black colored** bollards with a **paddle shaped body** are common in Utah and Wyoming, and can also be found in Nebraska.
NOTE: A white reflector that is in the shape of a [square](https://maps.app.goo.gl/f4rVfZo5AxSLTS5k7) on this bollard design can only be found in Wyoming
text_zh: 具有**槳狀本體**的**黑色**路樁在猶他州和懷俄明州很常見，在內布拉斯加州也能找到。
注意：此路樁設計上呈[正方形](https://maps.app.goo.gl/f4rVfZo5AxSLTS5k7)的白色反光板僅見於懷俄明州。

text: Bollards with **3 circular reflectors** attached to it are common in New Mexico.
text_zh: 附有 **3 個圓形反光板**的路樁在新墨西哥州很常見。

text: These simple **white** bollards with **black reflectors** are unique to Wisconsin.
text_zh: 這些附有**黑色反光板**的簡單**白色**路樁是威斯康辛州特有的。

text: Bollards where the reflector is shaped like a **square** are common in Utah, Arizona, and Idaho.
The Utah variant usually has [2 bolts](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zXgYeFd7TBuuRywv6), the Arizona variant usually has one bolt, and Idaho can have both 2 bolts and one bolt.
NOTE: Diamond bollards can be rotated on their side to look like squares. Use with caution.
text_zh: 反光板形狀像**正方形**的路樁在猶他州、亞利桑那州和愛達荷州很常見。
猶他州的變體通常有 [2 個螺栓](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zXgYeFd7TBuuRywv6)，亞利桑那州的變體通常有一個螺栓，愛達荷州則可能同時有 2 個螺栓或 1 個螺栓。
注意：菱形路樁可以側向旋轉看起來像正方形。請謹慎使用。

text: Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts use **small green and red rectangular signs** to mark the ends of bridges and guardrails.
NOTE: Not all bridges and guardrails in these states will have these markers.
text_zh: 緬因州、新罕布夏州和麻薩諸塞州使用**小型綠紅相間的長方形標誌**來標示橋樑和護欄的端點。
注意：這些州並非所有橋樑和護欄都有這些標示。

text: In Minnesota, these yellow signs with **vertical, black triangles** are placed before bridges at most major river crossings and at the beginnings and ends of guardrail sections on large highways.
text_zh: 在明尼蘇達州，這些帶有**垂直黑色三角形**的黃色標誌放置在多數主要河流交叉口的橋樑前，以及大型公路護欄區段的起點和終點。

text: These **white bollards**, with one side often painted [yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/Tt64mBZvxz5qYZhv9), and **stone barriers**, are specific to Uruguay.
text_zh: 這些**白色路樁**（其中一側通常漆成[黃色](https://goo.gl/maps/Tt64mBZvxz5qYZhv9)）以及**石製護欄**是烏拉圭特有的。

text: The most common bollard type is a small square concrete bollard that is painted **white with a red top**.
text_zh: 最常見的路樁類型是一個小型方形混凝土路樁，塗成**白色配紅色頂部**。

intro.lead: 路樁是進階玩家最愛的線索，形狀與反光片就能定國
body: 看四件事：柱體形狀（長方形、圓柱、扁平）、顏色、正面與背面反光片的形狀顏色、以及頂端的斜切角度。多數歐洲國家有專屬款式，看一眼就能確定。
反光片正反面往往不同，如果畫面裡同時看得到路的兩側，兩面一起比對可靠度更高。注意鄰國常有近似款，例如匈牙利與立陶宛，要靠細節區分。
